description: Was not in the room. The letter is hers.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Was not in the room. The water-wheel is his line.
name: Hamnet Shakespeare

description: Was not in the room. The dispute and the ballad are hers.
name: Judith Shakespeare

description: Was not in the room. The fault is hers to tell.
name: Susanna Shakespeare

description: Took the packet and handed up Anne's letter. He was not given a speech.
name: Thomas Hobbins

description: Read the letter at the Bell and did not answer it there.
name: William Shakespeare
